verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of LM Studio's licensing, pricing, or commercial/enterprise terms, so there is no documented way for a power-user to learn whether work use needs a paid license. Community comments only assert that the terms restrict work use; they do not show the vendor clearly stating paid commercial or enterprise options.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know whether commercial or enterprise use requires a paid license or subscription beyond the free community edition
